mobbin-skills-best-practices.description: Tells your agent what Mobbin can and can't do and how the Mobbin skills work together, so it picks the right one or says when Mobbin isn't the right tool. Read it first, before any other Mobbin skill or tools, when the user asks about Mobbin or its connection, or starts a design task Mobbin could help with, including one that's too big or outside what Mobbin does.

mobbin-skills-plain-writing.description: Makes every report a Mobbin skill writes read like a person wrote it, in plain interface terms. Use only when a Mobbin skill writes prose for the user or asks for this skill by name; not for writing outside Mobbin skills. Removes the tells of AI-generated writing (em dashes, puffery, design buzzwords, rule-of-three, sign-offs) without changing a fact or adding one.

mobbin-skills-redesign-screen.description: Redesign any screen from patterns real apps ship. Share a screenshot, your code or a design file, and the skill finds how apps on Mobbin handle the same screen. Explore a few directions or fix specific problems, and see the evidence behind each change. You get a before and after image and a short report. The redesign stays in your own design system, and anything that already works is kept. Use whenever the user points at a screen, section, or component they have, or at a reference, a Mobbin result, one or more Mobbin collections or the screens they saved, and asks to redesign, improve,…

mobbin-skills-search.description: Gets better results from every Mobbin search, so the references match what you're working on. Use before every call to search_screens, search_flows or search_sections. Covers the tool, writing an effective query, the mode, pulling more results, and what to do when a search falls short.
